desc: Add a 50-period simple moving average filter to only enter longs when price is above the SMA50.
Add ADX trend filter to only enter longs when ADX > 25, indicating strong trend conditions conducive to breakout strategies.
Add a volatility regime filter: only enter longs when the current ATR-to-price ratio is below its 20-period simple moving average, indicating breakouts from low volatility conditions.
Add a bullish candle filter: only enter longs when the current bar's close is above its open.
